propositions: On bug close, a best-effort caused_by link to the culprit ticket is auto-derived via git-blame over the pre-fix parent (fixing-commit~1) of the bug's file_impact.
Auto-derivation returns a culprit only when a strict majority (>50%) of blamed lines point to one commit that resolves to a ticket via its rebar-ticket: trailer; otherwise no link is drawn.
A --caused-by <id> parameter is threaded end-to-end (CLI _parse_flags 5-tuple, transition_compute, close_ticket, and the _lib_writes transition() facade) to augment or override the derived link.
The caused_by edge is written via _write_link_event directly on the already-closed bug, bypassing the closed-source and cycle guards so the close-path status commit does not swallow it.
Failed or ambiguous blame resolution never blocks the bug close, and the link event carries no confidence field (consuming provenance metric treats it as classified-confidence evidence).
A bug-template blame-hunt advisory section is added to docs/user-guide.md explaining when auto-derivation applies versus using --caused-by.
